Get ready to step into a new world at The Alice Hotel. Located in the heart of Tucson – a small town with a lot of strange occurrences – the Alice offers an eclectic experience with modern luxury. Inspired by the legendary Alices who have left their mark on pop culture, The Alice Hotel is a portal to the unexpected where every moment promises to be part of a fun journey.
